<ns0:uscDoc xmlns:ns0="http://xml.house.gov/schemas/uslm/1.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://xml.house.gov/schemas/uslm/1.0 USLM-1.0.15.xsd" xml:lang="en" identifier="/us/usc/t42"><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c506c34-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s12112/b/5"><ns0:num value="5">(5)</ns0:num><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c506c35-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s12112/b/5/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> not making reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant or employee, unless such covered entity can demonstrate that the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of the business of such covered entity; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c506c36-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s12112/b/5/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> denying employment opportunities to a job applicant or employee who is an otherwise qualified individual with a disability, if such denial is based on the need of such covered entity to make reasonable accommodation to the physical or mental impairments of the employee or applicant;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:uscDoc>

accepted.summary: A covered entity must make reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant or employee, unless the covered entity can demonstrate that the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of its business.
accepted.quote: (A) not making reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant or employee, unless such covered entity can demonstrate that the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of the business of such covered entity; or

accepted.summary: A covered entity must not deny employment opportunities to a job applicant or employee who is an otherwise qualified individual with a disability, if such denial is based on the need of the covered entity to make reasonable accommodation to the physical or mental impairments of the employee or applicant.
accepted.quote: (B) denying employment opportunities to a job applicant or employee who is an otherwise qualified individual with a disability, if such denial is based on the need of such covered entity to make reasonable accommodation to the physical or mental impairments of the employee or applicant;
